final_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Boot, and React.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and removed double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, run locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain 3+ years of professional software development experience at a company; this role requires non-internship tenure you do not yet have.
Study and apply design patterns (e.g. Singleton, Factory, Observer, Strategy) in your projects and document them in project descriptions or a portfolio.

Learn distributed systems concepts (e.g. eventual consistency, partitioning, replication) and implement a small multi-service project (e.g. microservices with message queues) to demonstrate understanding.
Participate in code reviews on open-source projects or in a team setting; highlight this experience once you have it.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a fresher (graduating 2025) with no professional experience; this role requires 3+ years of non-internship software development and 2+ years of systems design. Your projects show solid full-stack fundamentals, but you must gain professional tenure and hands-on experience with distributed systems, design patterns, and code review practices before you are competitive for this level.
